```{python}
import pickle
import pandas as pd

injury_df = pd.read_pickle("../../3_Data_intermediates/2_Chemical_measurements/Chem_Injury_df")
```

```{r}
# Read in the data
data <- py$injury_df %>% 
  as.data.frame()
head(data)

out_dir <- "../../5_Plots/2_Chemical_measurements/Correlations"
out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "Injury_Protein_vs_all_scatterplots.pdf")

# Create directory if it doesn't exist
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Columns to plot against Injury_Protein
vars <- setdiff(names(data), "Injury_Protein")

# Open PDF device (one page per plot)
pdf(out_pdf, width = 8.5, height = 6.5, onefile = TRUE)

for (v in vars) {
  x <- 10^data[[v]]
  y <- data$Injury_Protein

  # Keep only complete cases and finite values
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)

  # Default text if not enough data
  r2_txt <- "R^2 = NA"
  p_txt  <- "p = NA"

  if (sum(keep) >= 3 && length(unique(x[keep])) >= 2) {
    fit <- lm(y[keep] ~ x[keep])
    sm  <- summary(fit)
    r2  <- sm$r.squared
    p   <- sm$coefficients[2, 4]  # p-value for slope

    r2_txt <- sprintf("R^2 = %.3f", r2)
    p_txt  <- if (is.finite(p)) sprintf("p = %.3g", p) else "p = NA"
  }

  # Plot
  plot(
    x[keep], y[keep],
    xlab = v, ylab = "Injury Protein (mg/mL)",
    main = paste("Injury_Protein vs", v),
    pch = 16
  )

  # Optional regression line (only if model was fit)
  if (sum(keep) >= 3 && length(unique(x[keep])) >= 2) {
    abline(fit, lwd = 2)
  }

  # Add annotation (top-left)
  usr <- par("usr")
  x_pos <- usr[1] + 0.03 * (usr[2] - usr[1])
  y_pos <- usr[4] - 0.06 * (usr[4] - usr[3])
  text(x_pos, y_pos, labels = paste(r2_txt, p_txt, sep = "\n"), adj = c(0, 1))
}

dev.off()

cat("Saved PDF to:\n", out_pdf, "\n")
```

# Individual chemicals
```{r}
out_dir <- "../../5_Plots/2_Chemical_measurements/Correlations"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

make_plot <- function(df, xvar, yvar = "Injury_Protein", out_dir, size_in = 4) {
  stopifnot(xvar %in% names(df), yvar %in% names(df))

  d <- df[, c(xvar, yvar)]
  d <- d[is.finite(d[[xvar]]) & is.finite(d[[yvar]]), , drop = FALSE]
  d <- na.omit(d)

  # Fit + R^2 (guard against too few points / constant x)
  r2_txt <- "R^2 = NA"
  if (nrow(d) >= 3 && length(unique(d[[xvar]])) >= 2) {
    fit <- lm(d[[yvar]] ~ d[[xvar]])
    r2  <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    r2_txt <- sprintf("R^2 = %.3f", r2)
  } else {
    fit <- NULL
  }

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = paste0(xvar, " (log(mol/L))"),
         y = "Total protein (mg/mL)") +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = Inf, label = r2_txt,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.5)

  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    p <- p + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
  }

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(yvar, "_vs_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", xvar), ".png"))
  ggsave(out_file, plot = p, width = size_in, height = size_in, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  out_file
}

dibenzofuran_file <- make_plot(data, "Dibenzofuran", out_dir = out_dir, size_in = 4)
retene_file       <- make_plot(data, "Retene",      out_dir = out_dir, size_in = 4)

```
